resources.string: A Lightning wallet that keeps your bitcoin with a mint you choose. Your recovery phrase stays on this device.
This removes this account from this phone: its recovery phrase, its bitcoin and its settings. Other accounts are not affected.
Trust a mint by its signing key: zaps from trusted mints are marked with a check. If a mint ever signs with a different key, it is no longer trusted.
%1$s now signs with a different key than when you first connected. Until you accept the new key, your wallet doesn\'t send or receive there. Your bitcoin there is unchanged.
Only do this if you know why %1$s changed its key, for example because its operator announced it. If someone else is answering in its place, your bitcoin there and anything you send can be lost.
Lets another app see the bitcoin paid to this address, but never spend it.
Answers, but can\'t hold bitcoin
The app forgets it, its signing key and whether you trust it. Your bitcoin and history stay. If you add it again later, it\'s like the first time: the key it shows then is the one the app remembers.
